title: oenothera greggii var. lampasana
intro: Oenothera greggii var. lampasana, commonly known as Desert Evening Primrose, is a plant species within the evening primrose family (Oenotheraceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to soothe skin conditions, such as eczema and dermatitis, as well as alleviate symptoms of menopause and other hormonal imbalances. The therapeutic actions of Desert Evening Primrose include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and estrogenic activities, which may also support the health of the cardiovascular system and immune system. Bioactive constituents of Oenothera greggii var. lampasana include isoflavones, particularly genistein and daidzein, as well as other phytochemicals with potential medicinal properties.
